title.zh-CN: 哭闹后青紫、吃奶差 · 生后16小时男婴
title.en: Cyanosis after crying and poor feeding · boy aged sixteen hours

summary.zh-CN: 新生儿喂养障碍伴多个形态和肌张力异常，需要先评估安全再整合染色体证据。
summary.en: Neonatal feeding difficulty accompanies multiple morphological and tone abnormalities; assess safety before integrating chromosome evidence.

provenance.citation: 张晶卉, 乔娜娜, 李文, 王纪文. 新生儿9p部分单体综合征一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2013;51(09):697-698. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2013.09.015.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 整合喂养、肌张力和形态异常识别综合征。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate feeding, tone and morphology to identify a syndrome.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分核型结果与遗传来源的未确定性。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish the karyotype result from uncertain inheritance.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 避免将母体用药或单例死亡当作确定因果和预后。
learningOutcomes.en: Avoid treating maternal medicines or one death as certain causation or prognosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 优先喂养呼吸安全并诚实说明遗传和预后不确定性
learningOutcomes.en: Prioritise feeding/respiratory safety and communicate genetic/prognostic uncertainty

text.zh-CN: 保暖营养支持后哭声肌张力改善、未再青紫，但仍不能自行吃奶而鼻饲，原始反射仍未引出。家属停止治疗出院，2月龄因全身衰竭死亡，具体机制未详。
text.en: Warming/nutritional support improved cry and tone and cyanosis stopped, but tube feeding remained necessary and primitive reflexes were still absent. The family withdrew treatment; death from generalised failure occurred at two months, without a detailed mechanism.

text.zh-CN: 多系统形态异常、低张力和喂养障碍的染色体病可能
text.en: Possible chromosomal disease with multi-system morphology, hypotonia and feeding difficulty

feedback.zh-CN: 这些共同线索需要遗传评估，并先保障喂养呼吸。
feedback.en: The combined clues warrant genetic assessment alongside feeding/respiratory safety.

text.zh-CN: 心超正常即可解释青紫为良性
text.en: Normal echocardiography makes cyanosis harmless

feedback.zh-CN: 仍需评估气道、喂养和其他生理原因。
feedback.en: Airway, feeding and other physiological causes remain relevant.

text.zh-CN: 孕期中药已被证明造成所有异常
text.en: Antenatal herbs are proven to cause every abnormality

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告没有确立因果关系。
feedback.en: The report does not establish causation.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 核型支持9p部分缺失，不能确定是新发还是亲本重排
text.en: Karyotype supports partial 9p deletion without establishing de novo origin versus parental rearrangement

feedback.zh-CN: 亲属表型正常不能替代家系检测。
feedback.en: Normal family appearance does not replace genetic testing.

text.zh-CN: 父母健康即可确定新发变异
text.en: Healthy parents prove a de novo deletion

feedback.zh-CN: 平衡重排携带者可能表型正常。
feedback.en: Balanced rearrangement carriers may appear normal.

text.zh-CN: 轻度酰基肉碱升高已确诊第二种遗传代谢病

text.zh-CN: 评估误吸和喂养支持、低张力与内分泌问题，提供非指责性遗传和家庭支持

feedback.zh-CN: 不能只给染色体标签而忽略眼前功能与家庭需求。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：整合喂养、肌张力和形态异常识别综合征。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：精细缺失范围、亲本核型、误吸评估、激素复核及死亡具体机制。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Integrate feeding, tone and morphology to identify a syndrome. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Precise deletion, parental karyotypes, aspiration assessment, endocrine reassessment and mechanism of death. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 核型证实9p部分缺失伴多系统发育异常，功能与家系信息仍不完整。

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 区分核型结果与遗传来源的未确定性。

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 避免将母体用药或单例死亡当作确定因果和预后。
teachingPoints.en: Avoid treating maternal medicines or one death as certain causation or prognosis.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 精细缺失范围、亲本核型、误吸评估、激素复核及死亡具体机制。
unknowns.en: Precise deletion, parental karyotypes, aspiration assessment, endocrine reassessment and mechanism of death.

references: 张晶卉, 乔娜娜, 李文, 王纪文. 新生儿9p部分单体综合征一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2013;51(09):697-698. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2013.09.015.
